question.text:
The statements $P$ and $Q$ are related to matrices $A$ and $B$, which are conformable for both addition and multiplication.

$$
\begin{aligned}
& P:(A+B)^{\top}=A^{\top}+B^{\top} \\
& Q:(A B)^{\top}=A^{\top} B^{\top}
\end{aligned}
$$


Which one of the following options is CORRECT?

  1. $P$ is TRUE and $Q$ is FALSE
     
  2. Both $P$ and $Q$ are TRUE
     
  3. $P$ is FALSE and $Q$ is TRUE
     
  4. Both $P$ and $Q$ are FALSE
question.subject: Linear Algebra
